thread:
erin: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — saw repeated cross-region LB retries during the 503 spike. Draft postmortem is up, we need clear owners for remediation and an ETA.

mike: Observed a spike of TLS handshake failures that line up with the retries. Logs show repeated SNI mismatches: `TLSError: SNI mismatch (cert_id=0x7f8a)` — might be a cert routing issue between regions.

sasha: I'll take ownership of the routing fix. Plan: diff route table + LB config, add fallback route priority, and run staging validation. Target ETA: 2026-04-05.

priya: I'll own monitoring and detection. I'll add a synthetic canary across regions and an alert if retry rate > 1% for 3m. ETA: 2026-03-30.

ben: I'll own cert validation/rotation logic. Proposal: add preflight SNI checks in CI and a periodic cert health job. ETA: 2026-03-28.

erin: Thanks — summarize action items in the postmortem ticket and attach PR links when ready. Current action list: 1) routing fallback & validation (sasha) 2) cert preflight + periodic checks (ben) 3) cross-region canary + dashboard (priya) 4) runbook + rollback steps (mike).

mike: I'll update the runbook with explicit rollback and fallback rules, plus an escalation step if cross-region latency > 200ms. Will add quick commands for triage.

incident-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1798765432/actions — items added for owners.

priya: Small note from the logs: retries were clustered between 03:12-03:18 UTC and correlated with a deploy to us-west. Heatmap shows spike also hitting us-east proxies.

ben: Repro tip: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood.test:443:10.0.0.5 https://api.redwood.test/health` returns TLS handshake errors in the failing windows. Saving full tcpdump in the incident artifact.

sasha: Can we do a quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to go over timeline and test plan? I'll draft the timeline in the ticket.

erin: 10:00am PT works for me. Please add owners to JIRA: RW-3456 (routing fix), RW-3457 (cert preflight), RW-3458 (monitoring).

priya: I'll add a dashboard widget with a regional retry heatmap and SNI failure rate. Also adding an alert runbook entry.

ben: I'll put a pre-deploy e2e in CI that hits all regions and validates the cert chain. Script reference: `scripts/ci/check_sni.sh` — I'll open the PR today.

mike: Important: this looks like a recurrence of a previous pattern (similar symptoms to 1769001234). Recommend we mark this 'recurring_incident' and add tactical guardrails (enforced canaries + preflight) rather than just a one-off patch.

erin: Agreed. Labeling as recurring and scheduling a 90-day follow-up review. Priya, can you own the 90-day check?

priya: Yep — I'll set a reminder for 2026-06-30 and own the follow-up.

ben: Marking tasks in the tracker as in-progress. Will post PR links here once CI passes.

ers: (typo correction) -> erin: small correction: please ensure runbook references the internal LB runbook and the cert inventory.

sasha: ok.

ben: ok.

mike: ack.

priya: ack.

erin: Owner summary: sasha (routing), ben (certs), priya (monitoring + 90-day), mike (runbook). Weekly check-ins until all items are closed. :thumbsup: Keep updates in this thread so the incident artifact is complete. Closing initial thread — add progress updates here.
